description.content: In most cases, regular users should not call this endpoint. It will typically be used by a batch processing system to send updates regarding the execution of the job. If using a non-user-associated token for authorization, the token must be granted the "jobs.job_<id>" scope, where <id> is the ID of the job being updated.

query.description: A message to add to the job's log field. If you want to overwrite any existing log content, pass another parameter "overwrite=true".
